info.title: LitSense API
info.description: Backend for the LitSense web app. Cookie auth with rotating refresh tokens; unsafe requests need X-CSRF-Token from GET /auth/csrf. Errors use { error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }.

get.summary: Get a CSRF token (send it as X-CSRF-Token on every unsafe request)
